items.label: MA-AG civil: Just Energy Group Inc. and its affiliates
items.detail: Assurance of discontinuance filed in Suffolk Superior Court over deceptive electricity marketing, unauthorized switching and termination fees; date is the announcement date taken from the release URL and context. Just Energy pays $4 million: $3.8 million to a restitution trust fund plus $200000 to the Commonwealth; release says nothing on admission. | One total paid by entities of this one company: counted once, in full, $4,000,000 (data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).
